y-m-38-02.s.s3.explain: Kuenda kunopa nzira n×m; kudzoka, sezvo mugwagwa wakashandiswa pakuenda muchikamu chimwe chete wabviswa, kunopa nzira (m−1)×(n−1) nekutevedzana, saka huwandu hwose i n(n−1)×m(m−1) nzira.
